label: PREVIEW CORPUS — SIMULATED. NOT YOUR DATA.
query: Where are we with the launch — what actually matters right now?

nodes.summary: Simulated project: shipping a local-first memory preview.
Simulated cofounder in the preview corpus.

events.title: Drew the trust line for the launch
events.summary: Decided the launch ships local-first: no raw transcripts, no backend keys, wipe always available. The line everything else hangs on.

events.title: The burnout ship that broke the launch demo
events.summary: Pushed the launch while exhausted and the demo broke on stage. The lesson that shipping tired costs more than shipping late.

events.title: Repaired the rift with Sam about the launch scope
events.summary: After the scope fight we sat down and rebuilt the launch agreement: smaller cut, honest labels, no silent compromises.

events.title: Morning run, then the launch plan finally clicked
events.summary: Clear-headed after a run: mapped the launch cut list, picked the one demo that matters, and felt the plan settle.

events.title: First outside user ran the launch preview end to end
events.summary: Watched a stranger install the preview, follow the demo, and smile at the resume. Proof the launch story lands.

events.title: 3am hotfix before the launch freeze
events.summary: Four hours of sleep, hands shaking, shipped the hotfix anyway. The launch date is eating the body budget.

events.title: Cut the viewer from the launch to make the date
events.summary: Deadline panic decision: dropped the trust viewer from the launch scope and hated every minute of it.

events.title: Conflict with Sam over cutting safe mode from the launch
events.summary: Argued about whether safe mode belongs in the launch at all. Said things I regret; the conflict is still warm.

events.title: Dismissive review called the launch a wrapper
events.summary: A reviewer waved the launch off as 'another memory wrapper'. Wrote an angry rebuttal at midnight and deleted it.

events.title: Tuesday standup notes
events.summary: Routine sync: tickets moved, nothing decided, calendar shuffled.

events.title: Renamed a config flag for the launch build
events.summary: Mechanical rename across the launch build scripts; CI stayed green.

events.title: Bumped the CI runner image
events.summary: Dependency bump, ten minutes, nothing interesting.

events.title: Lunch thread about launch page icons
events.summary: Bikeshed about icon weight on the launch page; parked it.

events.title: Drafted a launch tweet
events.summary: Wrote three versions of a launch tweet, scheduled none.

events.title: Wrote the ingest consent rule for the launch
events.summary: Locked the rule: real user context enters memory only by explicit opt-in, never by default scan.

events.title: Made doctor the gate before any launch demo
events.summary: Agreed no demo runs unless doctor proves full retrieval is actually on. No fake demos.

continuity.summary: Launch prep: trust line drawn, scope repaired with Sam, doctor gates every demo. Body budget is the live risk.
decisions: Local-first launch: no raw transcripts, no backend keys, wipe always available.
No demo without doctor proving full retrieval is on.
Real user context enters memory only by explicit opt-in.
open_loops: Restore the trust viewer that was cut from the launch scope.
Close the loop with Sam after the safe-mode argument.
do_not_repeat: Do not ship the launch exhausted — the burnout ship already cost one demo.
emotional_anchors: The burnout ship on stage is the wound the launch must not repeat.

restored / shipping morning (good sleep, high HRV, plan energy)
